title: FCA Handbook — SYSC
html:
SYSC 4.1 General requirements

SYSC 4.1.1 R 01/01/2022

A firm must have robust governance arrangements, which include a clear organisational structure with well defined, transparent and consistent lines of responsibility.

SYSC 4.1.1A R 03/01/2018

A common platform firm must comply with the requirements in article 21 of the MiFID Org Regulation.

SYSC 4.1.1AA G 03/01/2018

The MiFID Org Regulation applies directly to common platform firms.

SYSC 4.1.2R 01/01/2022

A firm must establish, implement and maintain adequate risk management policies and procedures.
